authorization: Publisher explicitly authorised three verified daily company-analysis articles on 2 November 2026, superseding the repository's one-new-article daily cap.
story_thesis: Nike's margin improvement is currently cost-led; a durable turnaround requires footwear, direct-channel and Greater China demand to recover without heavy promotion.

identity.units: USD millions except per-share and percentage data

duplicate_checks: Checked editorial index, Markdown and JSON inventories and actual wealth sources; Nike has a stock profile but no dedicated margin-versus-demand analysis.
Checked open and recently merged pull requests and recent company-publication records; no Nike publication attempt or matching fingerprint was active.
Checked live site content before drafting; no canonical article answers this question.
The article focuses on direct-channel and product economics rather than publishing a routine quarterly recap.

evidence_table.claim: Revenue was USD11.213bn, down 4%, and gross margin was 42.8%, up 60 basis points.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Results release financial highlights and 10-Q MD&A.
evidence_table.result: verified in separate fact-check pass; fiscal Q1 2027 correctly distinguished from calendar 2027

evidence_table.claim: Gross profit fell to USD4.798bn from USD4.943bn, approximately 2.9%, while operating profit was USD907m versus USD904m.
evidence_table.result: verified; article rounds gross-profit decline to about 3%

evidence_table.claim: Overhead fell 6% to USD2.658bn while demand creation rose 5% to USD1.252bn.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Selling and administrative expense table and MD&A.

evidence_table.claim: Nike Direct revenue fell 8% to USD4.142bn; Digital fell 13%, stores 5%, while wholesale revenue was USD6.804bn, down 1%.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Channel revenue tables; reported-currency percentages used unless the article explicitly states constant currency.

evidence_table.claim: Footwear revenue fell 6% to USD6.951bn; unit sales fell 5% and average selling price reduced growth by one percentage point.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: NIKE Brand product revenues and 10-Q footwear analysis.

evidence_table.claim: Greater China revenue fell 22% to USD1.180bn, 26% in constant currency, and EBIT fell 34% to USD248m.
evidence_table.result: verified; reported and constant-currency measures kept separate

evidence_table.claim: Inventory was USD7.846bn, down 3% year on year but up 5% from 31 May due to product mix.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Release balance-sheet highlights and 10-Q inventory MD&A.
evidence_table.result: verified; article explicitly says the comparisons use different starting points

evidence_table.claim: Pace targets USD2.5bn cumulative savings through fiscal 2031 with about USD1bn programme charges, plus USD300m of fiscal 2026 severance; about USD300m programme charges expected in fiscal 2027.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Release outlook and 10-Q transformation programme note.
evidence_table.result: verified; savings stated before charges and reinvestment

evidence_table.claim: Fiscal 2027 guidance calls for a high-single-digit revenue decline and adjusted EPS of USD1.15-1.35 excluding about USD0.15 of restructuring charges.
evidence_table.result: verified and labelled management guidance, not a guaranteed result

fact_check_pass.method: After drafting, material figures, fiscal-period labels, currencies, reported and constant-currency measures, transformation charges, guidance and calculations were reread against both SEC primary documents.
